title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
firstLine: In my younger and more vulnerable years my father gave me some advice that I’ve been turning over in my mind ever since.
begins: The narrator, Nick Carraway, recalls his father’s advice to reserve judgement. He came East from the Middle West to work in the bond business and rents a small house on Long Island next to a huge mansion.
happens: Nick lives next door to the mysterious millionaire Jay Gatsby, who throws lavish parties. Nick’s cousin Daisy lives across the bay with her wealthy husband Tom Buchanan, who has a mistress, Myrtle Wilson. Gatsby loves Daisy and has Nick arrange a meeting; they begin an affair. After a tense scene in a New York hotel, Daisy, driving Gatsby’s car, kills Myrtle. Tom tells Myrtle’s husband George that Gatsby was the driver; Wilson shoots Gatsby in his pool and then himself. Almost no one comes to the funeral, and Nick returns West.
